findings.text: follow-on: the report lists forward.py:934 and forward.py:1385/1390 as eager production hosts whose input class includes an unqualified intermediate, so the new refusal in _support_partition changes their behaviour from serving achieved labels to raising NoQualifiedAxisError. The landed test asserts the refusal only through the fixture route in tests/test_fused_same_state_read.py; none of the three production hosts, nor the benchmark/script eager hosts the report enumerates, is exercised, so a regression that silently re-served those states would pass the gate.

follow-on: _first_unqualified_map_state drives the relaxed map until _fixed_design_read reports no admitted axis and then asserts the refusal on that state; it depends on the map leaving the qualified region within HOST_EVALUATIONS, raising a bare AssertionError otherwise, so a longer route to the unqualified region would fail the test for the wrong reason (fixture exhaustion) rather than on the guard.

gate_arms_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite gate logs. baseline_suite.failure_ids and after_suite.failure_ids are the same three node ids (all in tests/test_forward_operator_domain.py), so the head-minus-base set is empty: added_failure_count is 0 and added_failure_ids is empty by a measured set identity, not by an absent arm. justifications.durability: The change ships a genuine guard: removing the added require_qualified_axis(admitted) call makes the new refusal test fail with DID NOT RAISE NoQualifiedAxisError at tests/test_fused_same_state_read.py:232, and the test is unmarked so it runs in the default fast lane; held below full because the three production eager hosts the change makes fail-closed have no regression test.
justifications.evidence: Both arms' logs are header-stamped with revision, tree, module file path and cwd, and this review re-ran the arms independently and reproduced the failure sets value-for-value (head 3 failed / 12 passed; base fast modules 3 failed / 10 passed, the same three ids).
justifications.fit: The change sits in nova/equilibrium beside the existing require_qualified_axis, adds no abstraction, carries no plan or ticket label, and the node measured on the CPU lane without touching a GPU or a solve.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The change under review carries the qualified-axis refusal into the fused linear read exactly as its commit body states, and the reviewed node measured it on the three modules outside its own gate, which is its whole purpose.
justifications.scope_discipline: The landed diff is exactly two files (one guard line in nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py plus a rewritten tests/test_fused_same_state_read.py), and the measurement-only node wrote only its declared report.

notes: The reviewed node is a measurement-only wider gate: it holds no commit and reports that the axis-enforcement change at 571f4e8cc adds no failure in the three modules outside its own gate. This review reproduced both arms and confirms the added-failure set is empty (head 3 failed / 12 passed, base 3 failed / 10 passed plus the 2 passing two-branch tests, the same three ids), reproduced the change's own test module (4 passed), and falsified the guard with a negative control (removing the _support_partition guard reddens the refusal test). Scores: goal_fidelity 20, evidence 19, scope_discipline 20, durability 18, fit 20.

reproduction_of_repaired_defect.after: at head 571f4e8cc the call is bound to admitted and require_qualified_axis(admitted) is called before the partition is used; the fused route and read() now refuse the same state from identical inputs, and the test drops the try/except fallback that had hidden the divergence.
reproduction_of_repaired_defect.before: at base d786948c4, _support_partition (nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py) reads _fixed_design_read and discards the admitted flag, so the fused linear route returns achieved labels for a state with no admitted magnetic-axis candidate while read() raises NoQualifiedAxisError on the same state.
reproduction_of_repaired_defect.finding_id: the fused linear read served an unqualified intermediate state the two-request read route refuses (the divergence the commit body names)
